_README: TEMPLATE — NOT SHIPPABLE. Every #FF00FF (light) and #7FFF00 (dark) is a tripwire placeholder that must be replaced. If these render in a browser, the tokens were never chosen. Name by role, never by value. Color is layers (brand, semantic, state, surface, text, border, data) that never share a hue by accident. Neutral tint is a decision with a trace. A second theme exists only if warranted and is designed independently.

light._optional: brand-primary, brand-secondary when brand identity and action color differ; data-positive, data-negative, data-neutral, data-1..6 for data-led products — never sharing a hue with brand or semantic

dark._note: Only if warranted (low light, long sessions, platform expectation). Base 8-12% lightness, never #000. Elevation by lightness. Hues desaturated and lightened. Text off-white, never #FFF. Re-measure every pairing.

font._note: Choose by property (x-height, width, script coverage, tabular figures, distinctiveness, platform fit), not by list. One face is complete for most products; display only when the headline carries voice; mono only for code/data. Confirm script coverage first.

fontSize._note: Generated from a ratio chosen by reading context: 1.125-1.2 dense repeated use; 1.2-1.25 product UI; 1.25-1.333 marketing; 1.414+ only when one statement carries the screen. Display:body ratio is a consequence, not a target.

radius._note: CHOOSE one scale of 2-3 steps and hold it; position from brand and platform. Nested inner = outer - padding is correct.
